turns.q: How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
turns.replyTail:
use correctly, mount it securely 3 to 5 feet off the ground on a morning-facing wall, fence, or post (south to southeast) so it receives morning sun, and ensure it does not sway in the wind.
Insert the natural reeds into the house as far back as possible so they are protected by the roof overhang. Lightly spray the open ends of the reeds with the included InvitaBee™ attractant, ensure there is moist clay-rich mud within 10 to 20 feet, and then release your cocoons according to the instructions.
